rawFindings.title: Incorrect mountpath assignment in app.use when mounting sub-app
rawFindings.explanation: In the app.use function, when mounting an express sub-application, the mountpath is intended to be set to the resolved mount path (mount_path) rather than the original path argument (path). The patch correctly assigns mount_app.mountpath = mount_path. Without this fix, sub-apps mounted without specifying a path string (i.e., mounted at '/') would have an incorrect mountpath, potentially breaking path resolution in the application.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the assignment from 'mount_app.mountpath = path;' to 'mount_app.mountpath = mount_path;' as done in the patch, ensuring the sub-application's mountpath is correctly set to the resolved mount path.
